anatomical_zero: Anatomical position: standing upright, arms by the sides, forearms mid-pronation (palms toward the thighs), wrists and fingers straight, thumb alongside, head level, torso above the pelvis.

axes.applies_at: The anatomical zero. A robot arm uses its reference pose: upper arm and forearm pointing along -up, wrist in line, forearm roll turned to the anatomical zero (palm toward the thigh).
axes.description: positive.axis is the unit rotation axis, in the body frame (x forward, y left, z up of a body standing upright), of a positive angle by the right-hand rule. A sided limb's axis is the left limb's; a sideless limb's (torso, head, a single robot arm) is stated as is.

naming: <limb>.<joint>_<motion>; a sided limb is <limb>_left or <limb>_right in a channel key and sideless (<limb>) in a role id; a single-arm robot uses the sideless arm.

mirroring.description: Left and right share one sign convention, so a pose mirrors by swapping the left and right limb. No angle changes sign.
mirroring.axis_rule: The right limb's axis is the left limb's mirrored across the left-right plane. A rotation axis is a pseudovector, so the mirror keeps its left component and flips its forward and up components: (x, y, z) -> (-x, y, -z). With that axis the right limb's positive angle has the same sign as the left limb's, which is why no angle changes sign when a pose is mirrored by swapping limbs.

zero.reference: Upper arm and forearm in line (straight).

zero.reference: Mid-pronation (palm toward the thigh with the arm hanging).

zero.reference: Hand in line with the forearm.

positive.direction: Flexion: hand tilts toward the palm side. Negative is extension.
positive.axis_note: At the anatomical zero the palm faces the thigh, so palm-side tilt is a turn about the forward axis. The axis follows the forearm roll: it turns with arm.forearm_roll.

zero.reference: Hand in line with the forearm.

positive.direction: Ulnar deviation: hand tilts toward the little finger. Negative is radial.
positive.axis_note: At the anatomical zero (palm toward the thigh, thumb forward) the little-finger side is behind. The axis follows the forearm roll: it turns with arm.forearm_roll.
